_comment: PRE-WIRED settings for the bundled CoreWcf PayorList sample (see /sample). Run the test-page workflow for page 'PayorList'; you do not start the apps yourself: lifecycle.ps1 starts every app in 'Apps' (in array order) when it is not already healthy, logging to .kiro/app-testing/<Page>/logs/<name>.log. Apps[].project paths are relative to this test project dir. Apps[].healthAccept is 'status200' (default: up when the healthUrl returns HTTP 200) or 'anyResponse' (up on any HTTP response incl. 500, for SOAP/WCF .svc endpoints that reject GET; the process owning the port must also match the csproj name). Mark the app under test with isTarget:true (it is rebuilt/restarted when its sources are newer than the running process). Mark the app that holds the test data with resetData:true (PayorContracts.Host keeps payors in static in-memory lists): lifecycle.ps1 restarts it after every mutating module run (dataEffect mutating in plan.json) so the next module starts on fresh data. The sample runs locally with no auth, so Auth/AuthStateFilePath are unused.
_sourcePaths: Source folders of the two apps, relative to the repo root. The agents read them from status.json paths.reference / paths.target (written by lifecycle.ps1): the Reference source is never edited, Target fixes go only under TargetSourcePath.

VisualChecks._comment: Content sanity checks and geometry diff. On every step the harness scans the visible body text (innerText) for LeakedTokens (substring match) and StandaloneTokens (whole-token match, so 'NaN' matches but 'Nancy' does not) and records browser console errors / unhandled page errors (CaptureConsoleErrors). Target hits are Functional Gaps (leaked syntax HIGH, console/page errors MEDIUM); Reference hits are listed as Reference defects and never fail Target parity. Geometry: layout.* rows (from css-map.json roles grid|row|header|pager|filter) are flagged when |diff| > MinDiffPx AND diff% > MinDiffPct (diff% = |diff| / |Reference|); a flagged row is HIGH when |diff| > HighDiffPx OR diff% > HighDiffPct, else MEDIUM.
VisualChecks._inventoryComment: Automatic element inventory at every planned CSS state on both sides (CssCompareHelper): visible buttons, links, inputs, headings, labels, table headers/cells of the first MaxRowsPerGrid rows, images and messages with role, accessible name, box and normalized styles; written to runs/Module<X>/<System>/css/inventory_<state>.json. The report pairs Reference and Target elements (css-map.json pairs first, then by role + name + order + position, score >= MinMatchScore) and writes runs/Module<X>/match_<state>.json. InteractiveStates: hover/focus/disabled styles of the first MaxElements interactive elements, only in the listed states. Responsive: page re-inventoried at each width (states listed). IgnoreProperties: never compared on non-interactive elements. PageHealth: broken images, failed requests, empty sections, accessibility gaps (Target = Functional Gaps, Reference = Reference defects). Layout: alignment tolerance and minimum spacing diff.
VisualChecks._severityComment: Severity recalibration of style/state/mapped CSS rows (css-map severities given per property win). LOW (not actionable): font-size diff <= FontSizeLowPx; border-radius/padding/margin/border-width diff <= BoxLowPx; letter-spacing/line-height diff <= TextMetricLowPx; CIEDE2000 deltaE < DeltaELow; font-weight pairs in LowFontWeightPairs. MEDIUM above the px thresholds and deltaE DeltaELow..DeltaEHigh. HIGH: deltaE > DeltaEHigh on color/background of interactive elements or PrimaryRoles; Target contrast below ContrastMin where the Reference passes. Unparsable values keep their severity; every recalibrated row records its rule (runs/css_rows_all.md).
VisualChecks._groupsComment: Theme-level CSS groups per page (reports/CSS_Groups.md): rows with the same role class, property and normalized Reference/Target values are one finding; actionable counts are groups. ChatTop = actionable groups shown in chat views; ExampleElements = example labels per group.

_stackProfile: Shared stack knowledge in .kiro/test-project/profiles/<name>.json (role equivalences, selector hints, accepted-by-default differences with a reason, ignore lists). Applied before css-map.json 'accepted'; the report shows 'accepted by profile <name>: <reason>'. Empty = generic.json only.
